ov: Crustaceans with long bodies, long antennae and thin legs, which swim forward with paddles under the tail and flick backwards to escape. Thousands of species live in the sea and fresh water.

why.dm: Shrimp are farmed on a huge scale: about 440 billion farmed shrimp are slaughtered each year.
why.p: Several kinds are kept in home aquariums, such as cherry and Amano shrimp.
why.et: One of the most popular shellfish, widely caught or farmed.

rg: Most coasts and estuaries, plus rivers and lakes.
fx: The pistol shrimp’s claw snap fires a bubble at 90 km/h, and colonies are loud enough to disrupt sonar.
